exposure: Bottle use (during the first three months of life)
outcome: Prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding duration to the ages of three months
Prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding duration to the ages of six months
cohort: The study enrolled 42 Terena infants born between June 2017 and July 2018, living in villages within the urban area of Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul State, Brazil.
finding: Infants introduced to bottles during the first three months of life had a significantly lower median duration of exclusive breastfeeding (15 days) and lower prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding at three months (22.7%) compared to those never introduced to bottles (150 days and 80%, respectively).
